paras: Panaspis tancredii, the Ethiopian snake-eyed skink or Boulenger's dwarf skink, is a species of lidless skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Ethiopia.
The specific name, tancredii, is in honor of Italian explorer Alfonso Maria Tancredi (died 1942).
The preferred natural habitat of P. tancredii is grassland, at altitudes of about 3,000 m (9,800 ft).
The mode of reproduction of P. tancredii is unknown.
